description: WF-1 code-review adversarial golden (docs/design/sheet-metal.md §4.5.3 / §5): a 200 x 100 base (t = 1.5, r = 2, K = 0.44) with a 40 x 10 notch cut through the MIDDLE of the y=0 edge BEFORE folding, splitting it into two collinear segments x in [0, 80] and x in [120, 200]; a full-width 90-deg edge flange (leg 40) is folded off EACH surviving segment. The two bends are COAXIAL (the same y=0 bend axis line) AND equal-radius, differing only in along-axis extent/centroid — the natural extension of PB-1. It must DEVELOP (not false-reject): the construction disambiguates the second collinear flange's bend by its span, the development emits TWO BendLines, and the runtime fold-back cross-check measures each distinct bend face ONCE (deduped by TopoDS identity), so live widths [80, 80] == developed widths [80, 80] instead of the buggy [80, 80, 80, 80] N^2 count.
tangent_line_convention: Each leg is measured to its bend TANGENT LINE (§9 #1): the base develops to its notched 200 x 100 flat top face; each flange leg develops to 40 mm beyond a BA-length strip replacing its bend.
derivation: HAND-DERIVED analytic values (geometry-gates skill). Base 200 x 100 x t=1.5; notch 40 (x in [80,120]) x 10 (y in [0,10]) cut through the y=0 edge; two full-width flanges leg=40, width=80 each on the [0,80] and [120,200] segments. No auto bend-end relief: each flange spans its whole segment (blank corner + notch boundary, §4.5.2).

Envelope: 200 mm along the fold direction (base x-extent) x (100 + BA + 40) = 144.17831822927442 mm perpendicular. The emitter's canonical base frame maps the perpendicular extent to flat_length_mm and the along-fold extent to bend_width_mm.

Outline: ONE closed loop, 8 body edges (a comb: the base rectangle with a bottom-middle reentrant notch and two downward flange legs) + 2 fold lines, each spanning exactly one segment's 80 mm width at its strip midline.

Fold-back invariant: the two DISTINCT live inner bend faces each measure 80 mm == their developed width == authored segment width; live_bend_face_widths dedupes them to [80, 80] (the buggy per-signature scan would return [80, 80, 80, 80]), so the pipeline cross-check succeeds.
content_hash is the sha256 of FlatPattern.to_json_bytes() — determinism pin.
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (2026-07-22, build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9): flat_area residual 1 ulp, envelope exact, BA residual 1 ulp. 1e-9 ceiling matches the sibling partial-flange goldens; 1e-6 mm^3 volume tolerance (measured residual ~1e-11) matches the sheet-metal volume tolerance family.
